summary: Banco de Chile filed a Form 6-K disclosing the local-market placement of senior dematerialized bearer bonds. The issuance totaled CLF 1,300,000 (UF) under Series FT, maturing October 1, 2032, at an average placement rate of 2.92%. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. The filing is a regulatory notice to Chile's Financial Market Commission and local exchanges. No premium, share price, or strategic implications apply. What to watch: none; this is an ordinary bond placement with no risk-arb angle.
